newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to restructure ag ministry - Minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to restructure ag ministry - Minister.

text.p: Ukraine will restructure the Agriculture Ministry as part of its attempts to reform the sector, Deputy Prime Minister Mykhailo Zubets said on Friday.

"Unfortunately today's agriculture ministry was created according to a Stalinist model in 1947, and it hasn't changed since," Zubets, in charge of farming, told a conference of private business people involved in the agriculture sector.
"We need to implement some serious reforms," he said.
Departments for economic reform, market relations, and investments would be created as part of the reorganisation, he said.
